API Changelog

This document consolidates changelog entries from all API documentation files:
- Search API Documentation
- Users API Documentation
- Payments API Documentation
- Auth API Documentation

Entries are sorted newest first.

2026-03-18 | Search API: Added fuzzy matching and typo tolerance
2026-03-15 | Users API: Added pagination support to GET /users (limit, offset params)
2026-03-12 | Auth API: Added support for OAuth2 social login (Google, GitHub)
2026-03-10 | Payments API: Added support for recurring payments
2026-03-05 | Search API: Implemented search result highlighting
2026-03-01 | Payments API: Implemented webhook notifications for payment status changes
2026-02-28 | Auth API: Implemented multi-factor authentication (TOTP)
2026-02-20 | Users API: Added email verification endpoint POST /users/:id/verify
2026-02-15 | Payments API: Added refund endpoint with partial refund support
2026-02-10 | Search API: Added faceted search with filter aggregations
2026-02-01 | Auth API: Added refresh token rotation for security
2026-01-20 | Search API: Initial release of Search API
2026-01-10 | Users API: Initial release of Users API v2
